title: Galatians Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Galatians 5: standing firm in liberty, faith working through love, the deeds of the flesh, and the fruit of the Spirit.

questions.text: With what are the readers told not to be entangled again?
questions.explanation: They are told to stand firm in the liberty by which Christ has made them free, and not to be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

answers.text: With the troubles of this world
With a yoke of bondage
With the quarrels of the assemblies
With the teachers who flatter them

questions.text: What does Paul testify about every man who receives circumcision?
questions.explanation: He testifies again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

answers.text: That he is a debtor to do the whole law
That he will be counted among the Jews
That he has denied the promise of Abraham
That he must be taught the law again

questions.text: What does the chapter say counts in Christ Jesus, rather than circumcision or uncircumcision?
questions.explanation: It says that in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

answers.text: Zeal for the traditions
Keeping days and seasons
Faith working through love
Boasting in the flesh

questions.text: What short saying does the chapter use about yeast?
questions.explanation: It says that a little yeast grows through the whole lump.

answers.text: Yeast is hidden from the eye
Old yeast must be thrown out
A lump without yeast stays small
A little yeast grows through the whole lump

questions.text: In what saying does the chapter say the whole law is fulfilled?
questions.explanation: It says the whole law is fulfilled in one word: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.

answers.text: Do not steal from your neighbor
You shall love your neighbor as yourself
Honor your father and your mother
You shall have no other gods

questions.text: What does the chapter say follows from walking by the Spirit?
questions.explanation: It says that if you walk by the Spirit, you will not fulfill the lust of the flesh.

answers.text: That they will be praised by men
That they will never be troubled
That they will be kept from all suffering
That they will not fulfill the lust of the flesh

questions.text: What does the chapter say about those who are led by the Spirit?
questions.explanation: It says that if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

answers.text: That they are not under the law
That they will keep the whole law
That they must still be circumcised
That they will be free from all weakness

questions.text: What does the chapter say about those who practice the deeds of the flesh?
questions.explanation: After listing the deeds of the flesh, it forewarns that those who practice such things will not inherit God's Kingdom.

answers.text: That they will be taught again
That they will be judged by the law
That they will not inherit God's Kingdom
That they will lose their reward only

questions.text: What does the chapter list as the fruit of the Spirit?
questions.explanation: It says the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control.

answers.text: Love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, self-control
Wisdom, knowledge, prophecy, healing, tongues, mercy, zeal, strength, hope
Faith, hope, love, truth, light, mercy, honor, glory, courage
Prayer, fasting, almsgiving, silence, study, service, praise, labor, rest

questions.text: How does the chapter close its charge about one another?
questions.explanation: It says, let us not become conceited, provoking one another and envying one another.

answers.text: By telling them to teach one another the law
By telling them to wait for his coming
By telling them not to provoke or envy one another
By telling them to keep away from the Gentiles
